step_1_identify_the_effect.claim: 'Immolate' is a named unique passive shared by exactly three cached items.
step_1_identify_the_effect.derivation: data/economics-sourced.json -> groups_26_12.Immolate == ["Bami's Cinder", "Sunfire Aegis", "Hollow Radiance"], patch cdragon/ddragon 16.15.1. Item ids in data/items.json: 6660 Bami's Cinder, 3068 Sunfire Aegis, 6664 Hollow Radiance (a fourth, 223069 Void Immolation, is an Arena-only variant and is not in the SR group). Group membership means at most one Immolate source is priced in a legal loadout (exclusivity-group rule, docs/math-foundations.md 3.1: 'S respects exclusivity groups ... at most one item per group ... enforced by loadout_rules').

step_2_per_tick_raw_damage.modifiers: x1.60 vs minions and x2.00 vs monsters (Sunfire); x1.50 / x2.00 (Bami's); x1.25 vs both (Hollow Radiance). Champion targets take x1.00 - a bruiser roster is all champions, so no multiplier applies.
step_2_per_tick_raw_damage.cadence_and_uptime: 'Taking or dealing damage activates this passive for 3 seconds' - the window refreshes on every damage event, so in a continuous coupled fight uptime is 100% from the first damage event onward; the 3 s figure is a lapse timer, not a duty cycle.
step_2_per_tick_raw_damage.geometry: 325 (+ 100% bonus size) unit radius, applied to *enemies* (plural) - the tick is AoE and is NOT split across targets.

step_3_mitigation.identity: post = raw * m(R), m(R) = 100/(100+R) for R >= 0 (docs/math-foundations.md 2.1, 'apply_resistance'); magic damage, so R = target magic resistance. Mitigation is linear in raw, so per-tick mitigation and window-sum mitigation agree exactly (docs/math-foundations.md 1.2, item 1).
step_3_mitigation.tick_partition: Uniform partition, first tick at +interval, no immediate tick (docs/math-foundations.md 5, DoT-totals row) -> a T-second active window yields floor(T) ticks at interval 1 s.

step_4_roster_semantics.identity: roster_total_per_tick = SUM over enemies e in radius of raw_tick * m(MR_e).
step_4_roster_semantics.why: The wiki text applies one full tick to each enemy inside 325 units; nothing in the effect text divides damage by target count. Roster size scales the TOTAL linearly and leaves PER-TARGET damage invariant. Any capture that divides an Immolate tick across the roster, or that stacks two Immolate sources, would be wrong.

step_5_worked_numbers.target_stats: level-18 base magic resistance from data/champions.json via base + growth*(L-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(L-1)); at L=18 the bracket is exactly 1.0, so MR18 = base + 17*growth.
step_5_worked_numbers.note: The exact attacker build and roster composition of the golden scenario are defined outside the permitted evidence tree, so these are the value model instantiated at three stated bonus-health points, not a claim about which point the capture uses. The invariants in step_4 are build-independent and are the checkable content of the entry.

invariants_the_capture_must_satisfy: Per-target Immolate tick is independent of roster size; only the roster total scales with target count.
Sunfire raw tick = 20 + 1% bonus health; Bami's = 15 flat; Hollow Radiance = 15 + 1% bonus health.
Ticks are magic damage: mitigated by 100/(100+MR), never by armor, never true.
At most one Immolate item is priced in a loadout (named unique group of three).
No minion/monster multiplier applies against a champion roster (x1.00).
A T-second active window yields floor(T) one-second ticks, first tick at +1 s.

reasoning_for_verdict: This is an absent -> value membership transition: the prior baseline asserted nothing at this leaf, so 'old_value_correct' would have to mean the scenario should not exist. Nothing in the cached evidence supports that - Immolate is a live, SR-legal ('classic sr 5v5': true on all three items), well-specified multi-target burn family whose per-target/AoE and non-stacking semantics are exactly the kind of coupled behavior a roster scenario exists to pin, and it was previously uncovered. The effect constants the entry must rest on (20 + 1% bonus health, magic, 1 s cadence, 325 units, x1.00 vs champions, named-unique group of three) all reproduce cleanly from the cached wiki text, and the mitigation and tick-partition identities the capture must use are quoted verbatim from docs/math-foundations.md. No contradiction was found between the cached evidence and the addition of this leaf.
scope_limits: The literal captured payload was NOT byte-compared: the golden baseline and the scenario definition live under scripts/, outside the permitted evidence tree. The verdict certifies the value model and the legitimacy of the addition, not each captured float.

The attacker build (hence bonus health) and the exact roster membership of the scenario are likewise outside the tree; three bonus-health instantiations are given so any captured per-target figure can be checked against the formula.
